description: A source file implementing blame functionality, including structures and functions to compute blame origins, manage reference counts, perform diff-based blame computations, and handle line-level blame splitting. It interacts with git internal data structures, such as commits, trees, and blobs, to attribute lines of code to specific commits and authors.

classes.name: struct blame_origin
classes.description: Represents the source of blame for a particular file path in a commit, including reference counting, file path, parent information, and associated fingerprints.

classes.name: struct blame_entry
classes.description: Represents a line or range of lines attributed to a blame origin, including final line number, suspect origin, and linkage to the next entry.

classes.name: struct blame_scoreboard
classes.description: Maintains the state for blame computations, including references to commits, list of blame entries, buffers, and configuration options.

classes.name: struct fingerprint
classes.description: A data structure that computes and holds a fingerprint for a given line or string, used for similarity comparisons during blame analysis.

classes.name: struct blame_line_tracker
classes.description: Tracks whether a line in blame analysis is believed to belong to the parent or target.

classes.name: struct blame_chunk_cb_data
classes.description: Context passed during diff chunk callbacks to handle blame line splitting and attribution.

classes.name: struct handle_split_cb_data
classes.description: Context for handling blame splitting during diff hunks.

methods.name: struct:blame_origin * get_blame_suspects(struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Retrieves the blame suspects list for a given commit.

methods.name: void blame_origin_decref(struct blame_origin * o)
methods.description: Decreases reference count of a blame origin, freeing it if no longer used.

methods.name: struct:blame_origin * make_origin(struct commit * commit,const char * path)
methods.description: Creates a new blame origin structure for a commit and path.

methods.name: struct:blame_origin * get_origin(struct commit * commit,const char * path)
methods.description: Locates an existing blame origin for a commit and path, or creates a new one.

methods.name: struct:blame_origin * find_origin(struct repository * r,struct commit * parent,struct blame_origin * origin,struct blame_bloom_data * bd)
methods.description: Finds or creates the blame origin in a parent commit that corresponds to a given origin.

methods.name: struct:blame_origin * find_rename(struct repository * r,struct commit * parent,struct blame_origin * origin,struct blame_bloom_data * bd)
methods.description: Finds the renamed path in a parent commit, if any.

methods.name: struct:blame_entry * blame_merge(struct blame_entry * list1,struct blame_entry * list2)
methods.description: Merges two sorted linked lists of blame entries.

methods.name: void blame_sort_final(struct blame_scoreboard * sb)
methods.description: Sorts blame entries by final line number.

methods.name: sanity_check_refcnt
methods.description: Performs a sanity check to ensure no refcount underflow in blame origins.

methods.name: void blame_coalesce(struct blame_scoreboard * sb)
methods.description: Coalesces contiguous blame entries from the same origin.

methods.name: queue_blames
methods.description: Queues blame origins with their associated blame entries into the priority queue.

methods.name: void fill_origin_blob(struct diff_options * opt,struct blame_origin * o,mmfile_t * file,int * num_read_blob,int fill_fingerprints)
methods.description: Loads blob data for a blame origin, filling in its file contents and optional fingerprints.

methods.name: void drop_origin_blob(struct blame_origin * o)
methods.description: Releases the blob data associated with a blame origin.

methods.name: pass_blame_to_parent
methods.description: Diffs the target from its parent and attributes lines accordingly, passing blame through diff hunks.

methods.name: unsigned blame_entry_score(struct blame_scoreboard * sb,struct blame_entry * e)
methods.description: Computes a score indicating the triviality or significance of a blame entry.

methods.name: void copy_split_if_better(struct blame_scoreboard * sb,struct blame_entry * best_so_far,struct blame_entry * potential)
methods.description: Copies a blame split if it has a better score than the current best.

methods.name: void handle_split(struct blame_scoreboard * sb,struct blame_entry * ent,int tlno,int plno,int same,struct blame_origin * parent,struct blame_entry * split)
methods.description: Handles blame splitting at a particular place in the line set based on diff chunks.

methods.name: void find_copy_in_blob(struct blame_scoreboard * sb,struct blame_entry * ent,struct blame_origin * parent,struct blame_entry * split,mmfile_t * file_p)
methods.description: Finds matching lines in a blob for blame attribution.

methods.name: sort_blame_entries
methods.description: Sorts blame entries based on a comparison function.

methods.name: const char * blame_nth_line(struct blame_scoreboard * sb,long lno)
methods.description: Returns the content of the nth line in the blame buffer.

methods.name: split_overlap
methods.description: Splits a blame entry into parts overlapping with a parent, for blame attribution.

methods.name: split_blame
methods.description: Splits a blame entry at a specified line number.

methods.name: void decref_split(struct blame_entry * split)
methods.description: Decrements refcounts for blame entries resulting from a split.

methods.name: reverse_blame
methods.description: Reverses a blame list, appending a tail.

methods.name: split_blame_at
methods.description: Splits a blame entry at a specific line, with a new suspect.

methods.name: int are_lines_adjacent(struct blame_line_tracker * first,struct blame_line_tracker * second)
methods.description: Checks whether two blame line trackers correspond to contiguous lines from the same source.

methods.name: scan_parent_range
methods.description: Finds the most similar line in a parent fingerprint set based on similarity score.

methods.name: void guess_line_blames(struct blame_origin * parent,struct blame_origin * target,int tlno,int offset,int same,int parent_len,struct blame_line_tracker * line_blames)
methods.description: Guesses blame origins of lines within a diff chunk based on fingerprint similarities.

methods.description: Handles blame entries by assigning to parent or target, splitting as needed.

methods.description: Diffs and attributes blame lines from a target to a parent commit.

methods.description: Calculates a score for a blame entry based on the content's triviality.
